title: Thread in a new tool
label: A close view of a loom already weaving three tools, Chatwell, Forkyard and Paylane, each a band of coloured warp threads. A new spool labelled Sketchfold rolls onto the rod, and a threading hook draws its threads down through the heddle eyes and the reed to the cloth. From the next row on the cloth is woven four bands wide in Sketchfold's colour, the cloth steps out where the new band begins, Sketchfold's chip turns to Connected, and the beam's count reads four tools.
heading:
Add a tool in
about a minute.
sub: Pick it from the list and it's threaded in. The next row of work already carries it, next to everything you had.
